title: OpenMHS adapter registry entry
description: One adapter in the git-based registry (registry/README.md). An entry is a claim plus a pointer to evidence; it is never an endorsement, and nothing in it is executed to validate it.

id.description: The adapter's own id (`adapter.id` in its descriptor). Also the file name: registry/adapters/<id>.json.

protocol.description: How the adapter talks to the device. `builtin` is an in-process simulator.

maintainer.description: Who answers for the adapter. A name or a GitHub handle; no email addresses.

source.description: Where the code lives: an https URL, or a path inside this repository.

profiles.description: Device profiles or manifests shipped with the adapter, as paths or https URLs.

version.description: Adapter version the evidence was gathered for.

conformance_profile.description: The conformance level the adapter declares (spec/conformance.md); null if it declares none.

category.description: official: maintained in this repository. community: maintained elsewhere, with a conformance report. experimental: works in part or lacks full evidence. unverified: listed without evidence.

peer.description: What the report's adapter talked to: the project's in-process virtual lab, a protocol simulator reached over its real protocol, or a physical device. Required when there is a report. `device` is only accepted when the report's readings did not come from a simulator.

report.description: The conformance report this entry stands on, or null if there is none. A path inside this repository, with its SHA-256 so the reference cannot drift, and the date it was verified.
